verdict.rationale: Undermind takes an open-ended research goal in natural language and runs a deep literature review from it. Its official MCP server and published ChatGPT app let users drive search, PDF Q&A, note editing, folder curation and starring conversationally from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code. Community users confirm hands-on that natural-language research queries return useful results. Missing for 10: evidence that account-level functions such as alerts and settings can be run by natural-language commands, and independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language workspace management through the MCP or ChatGPT integrations.
